statement: Table-level restrictions can be bypassed by arbitrary SQL unless execute-sql permission is also restricted.
actakit_implication: Consumer APIs should expose bounded query capabilities, not unrestricted SQL over canonical/private tables.

statement: Shared plugin writes create blocking, namespace and privacy risks inside one SQLite database.
actakit_implication: Outputs/plugins should be read-oriented and isolated; mutation must route through core capabilities.

statement: Interactive facets/search are explicitly protected with row/time/thread limits.
actakit_implication: Queries and graph traversal need bounded depth/result/time budgets.
